map.工伤频率 FR = 伤亡人次 × 1,000,000 / 总工时: Injury frequency rate FR = recordable injuries × 1,000,000 / total hours
map.损工事故频率 LTIFR = 损工事件 × 1,000,000 / 总工时: Lost time injury frequency rate LTIFR = LTI events × 1,000,000 / total hours
map.百万工时死亡率 = 死亡人数 × 1,000,000 / 总工时: Fatality rate per million hours = fatalities × 1,000,000 / total hours
map.严重率 SR = 损失工作日 × 1,000,000 / 总工时: Severity rate SR = lost work days × 1,000,000 / total hours
map.TRIR（OSHA）= 可记录事件 × 200,000 / 总工时（200,00: TRIR (OSHA) = recordable cases × 200,000 / total hours (200,000 ≈ annual hours of 100 full-time employees)
map.平均损失工作日 = 损失工作日 / 损工事件: Average lost work days = lost work days / LTI events
map.提示：可记录事件含死亡、重伤、轻伤等需记录事故，本工具默认取三者和，可按企业口径: Tip: recordable cases include fatalities, serious injuries and minor injuries that must be recorded; this tool defaults to the sum of the three and you can adjust the inputs to your corporate definition.

map.同时统计事故频率（发生的频繁程度）与严重率（损失的严重程度），避免只看一面。: Report accident frequency (how often accidents occur) and severity rate (how serious the consequences are) together, so you do not only look at one side.
map.录入伤亡人次、损工天数、总工时，自动算出 FR 与严重率 SR。: Enter injuries, lost days and total hours to automatically compute FR and the severity rate SR.
map.用于安全例会汇报与持续改进目标设定。: Used for safety meeting reporting and for setting continuous improvement targets.
map.事故频率 FR = 伤亡人次 × 1,000,000 ÷ 总工时；严重率 SR: Accident frequency FR = recordable injuries × 1,000,000 ÷ total hours; severity rate SR = lost work days × 1,000,000 ÷ total hours (or weight injury severity by industry definition). Combining the two distinguishes "frequent minor injuries" from "rare major disasters".
map.总工时 1,500,000，伤亡 2 人次（损失工时共 30 天），则 FR =: With 1,500,000 total hours and 2 recordable injuries (30 lost work days in total), FR = 2×1e6/1.5e6 ≈ 1.33 and SR = 30×1e6/1.5e6 = 20; if another unit has the same FR but an SR of only 5, its accidents are milder and should be managed differently.
map.严重率怎么算更合理？: What is a more reasonable way to compute the severity rate?
map.常用损失工时天数归一化；也可按死亡/重伤/轻伤赋予不同权重，口径需在报表中注明保: Normalizing by days of lost work is common; you can also assign different weights to fatalities, serious and minor injuries, and the definition must be stated in the report and kept consistent.
map.频率低严重率高说明什么？: What does a low frequency with a high severity rate indicate?
map.事故少但单次后果重（如高处坠落、机械伤害），应强化本质安全与防护措施，而非仅靠减: Few accidents but severe consequences per occurrence (such as falls from height or machinery injuries), so inherent safety and protective measures should be strengthened rather than merely reducing frequency.
